Hi! Dog owners: About 5 years ago I had to look for help with trimming my dog's nails. It was a real surprise in a city the size of Helsinki. I went to several grooming salons and was always disappointed. Then the ad "PARTURRI MALMI dog grooming salon" I booked an appointment and now it's been successful. Many thanks to Johann. You are professional, calm and in the right field in every way. My dog ​​Roope has also been impressed.
Our 15-year-old dog Rio's coat received a professional treatment, the result was excellent! They were also really friendly towards the customer. Thank you and bow!

Very careful, professional and competent work! Our unpredictable Sheltie was at peace throughout the cleaning process and the end result was great. At home, the dog rolled around happily on the carpet. Definitely again!
